title: Wilhelm Scream
blurb: The Wilhelm Scream — cinema's most famous inside joke. This stock scream has appeared in over 400 films since 1951, from Star Wars to Indiana Jones, snuck in by sound designers as a tradition. Once you know it, you hear it everywhere. Use it for falls, explosions, and any moment that deserves a distinctly theatrical demise. A genuine piece of film history in button form.
origin: Recorded in 1951 for 'Distant Drums'; named after a character shot by an arrow in a 1953 western.
